jei.streamlined.generator: Burns coal or charcoal from its slot (400 ticks per item) and produces 20 FE/t. Pushes energy into adjacent storages and cables.
jei.streamlined.battery: Stores up to 10,000 FE. Fills and drains at 100 FE/t through cables.
jei.streamlined.cable: Connects generators, batteries and machines from other mods into one network. Throughput: 100 FE/t, limited by the slowest cable.
